references.text: The ark of the testimony is mentioned here, the same expression used in Joshua 4:16 regarding the ark carried by the priests.
The testimony that was to be placed inside the ark, which gives the ark its name 'ark of the testimony'.
The Levites carried the ark of the testimony, the same service performed by the priests at the Jordan.
The priests who carried the Lord's ark of the covenant went before the people, parallel to the role of the priests in Joshua.
The people were commanded to follow after the ark carried by the priests, the same pattern as during the crossing of the Jordan.
The priests with the ark stood in the Jordan until everything was completed, and then they came up out of the river.
Describes the very moment when the priests with the ark came up from the Jordan, a direct fulfillment of the command.
Joshua commanded the priests to take up the ark of the covenant, a similar command regarding the ark.
